messages:
sam: heads up — planning a weekend cutover for model routing + dedicated pin updates. target window: Sat 02:00–04:00 UTC. Need status page + customer email copy. cc @dina @leo

deploy-bot: release created: release/infra-cutover-2026-03-22 — canary deploy scheduled at 1765036800

dina: for SLA customers, we should add explicit fallback note. also confirm UTC->local for APAC. :india:

leo: APAC ops — prefer 03:00–05:00 JST? that would reduce impact. can we split regionally? :thinking:

maria: draft statuscopy below — keep short. please review

maria: ```
Status: Degraded performance for inference routing in APAC during scheduled maintenance.
Starting Sat 02:00 UTC, expected 2-hour window.
Affected: routing to dedicated pools; hosted API will fallback to compatible model variants.
No data loss expected.
```

sam: good start. add rollback decision statement and contact link. e.g., "If rollback required, we'll revert routing pins and notify within 15 minutes."

deploy-bot: smoke tests passing on canary. 3/4 OK, 1 flaky (kv-cache warmup). linking logs: https://logs.internal/r/abc123

dina: add customer-facing bullet about who to contact: support+dedicated@redwood.ai and include status page link. keep language plain.

leo: operational plan: step1 canary -> step2 regional pin -> step3 global cutover w/ 10m holdpoints. rollback plan: pin back previous model, requeue cached requests.

sam: can someone produce the short statuspage snippet we push? need <140 chars for SMS.

maria: SMS snippet: "Scheduled maintenance Sat 02:00 UTC — routing update may cause transient latency for APAC. Expected 2h. https://status.redwood.ai"

support-bot: suggested statuspage component: Routing -> maintenance -> start 2026-03-22T02:00Z -> description (maria draft). Recommended impact: Partial Outage.

sam: +1. final checklist: (1) support email template, (2) status page snippet, (3) scheduled automation to publish 1h prior, (4) oncall assigned: leo. I'll finish customer email and post here for sign-off by 17:00 UTC.

leo: I can take oncall. ping me in #eng-oncall at deploy time. :ok_hand:

dina: sign-off on copy. small nit: replace 'No data loss expected' with 'No data loss anticipated' — sounds less absolute.

maria: updated copy posted. ```
Status: Scheduled maintenance to update routing pins and dedicated pools starting Sat 02:00 UTC. Expected duration 2 hours.
Affected customers: possible increased latency for APAC regions.
No data loss anticipated.
Contact: support+dedicated@redwood.ai
```

sam: thanks — proceeding to schedule. will publish customer email draft in ~20m.

deploy-bot: scheduling automation set to publish statuspage at 1765033200 (1 hour prior).```
